lessonDecisions.note: The lesson applies to hooks or guards that map file writes to a project record or root. This task changes a SQL migration, the application's access hook and general limiter and unit tests; it contains no tool-call guard, pre-commit hook or root discovery, so none of the 'Applies when' conditions holds.
